'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling]]
**At least 29 [[sub-Saharan Africa]]ns are killed when two [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|boats sink]] off the coast of [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20230326-at-least-19-african-migrants-killed-in-latest-migrant-boast-disaster-off-tunisia (France 24)]
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 24–26, 2023]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] approves an emergency declaration for the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Mississippi]] following a storm that killed at least 26 people and caused significant damage, granting federal aid to affected areas of the state. [[Carroll County, Mississippi|Carroll]], [[Humphreys County, Mississippi|Humphreys]], [[Monroe County, Mississippi|Monroe]], and [[Sharkey County, Mississippi|Sharkey]] [[County (United States)|counties]] will be the main recipients. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/biden-declares-emergency-mississippi-due-storm-damage-2023-03-26 (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and another is missing after a fire breaks out on an oil tanker ship near [[West Nusa Tenggara]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesias-pertamina-says-two-crew-killed-after-fire-tanker-2023-03-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*A pipeline leak causes an [[oil spill]] at [[Poole Harbour]] in [[Dorset]], [[England]], in which more than 200 barrels of [[reservoir fluids]], including oil, leak into a [[Site of Special Scientific Interest]]. The [[RSPB]] reported sightings of oiled birds. ([https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-dorset-65090752 BBC News])

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Honduras relations]]
**[[Honduras]] switches its formal [[One China|diplomatic recognition of "China"]] from the [[Taiwan|Republic of China]] to the [[China|People's Republic of China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/honduras-government-says-ending-diplomatic-ties-with-taiwan-2023-03-26/ (Reuters)]

**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] dismisses [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defense Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] after Gallant called on the government to pause discussions on a [[2023 Israeli judicial reform|controversial judicial reform bill]].
